fields.label: City
fields.note: Search facet named city; counts returned by /api/jobs.

fields.label: Category
fields.note: Search facet categories; API accepted categories=Engineering.

fields.label: Employment type
fields.note: Collected from job records; no employment-type facet is exposed.

fields.label: Tags
fields.note: Search facet tags1 (the only extra facet besides country/city used by AMD's search config).

notes: AMD's Jibe/Radancy search app calls GET https://careers.amd.com/api/jobs with limit, page, keywords, categories, country, city and tags1. Verified: categories=Engineering&country=India&keywords=engineer returned 193 jobs and facet counts (city Bangalore 110, Hyderabad 83). The sort parameter is not documented by the page config, so no sort options are published.
